title: The Gravity of Halcyon Drift
author: Hazel Almeida
blurb: Mirabel Oyelaran, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. But when the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
